summary: Automation editor: the Runs tab (subject search, state chips, ↑ ↓), the run on the graph of its version with runOverlay (passed / failed / running / waiting / skipped, taken edges, attempt and item badges, failed-branch notes), 2 s polling of live runs, the node drawer (input, output, filtered logs), Cancel / Retry / Resolve for operators, and the Dry run (decision modes, captured effects, failed trigger condition) and Test node (confirmed irreversible effects, missing secrets) panels. EditorApi gains runs, run, version, cancelRun, retryRun, resolveRun and dryRun decisions; EditorProps gains automationId, can, runsView/onRunsView, subjectHref, onStartRun, connectionName. The graphs RPC adds automations.runs subject search, automations.dry_run decisions, catalog node idempotent/dry_run, the node of a wait, subject_url (graphs.Config.Links) and the /automations/runs/{run} link.
